opus.problem: The clue says the Lamb appeared 'beside the throne', but the BSB verse says 'standing in the center of the throne'. Change 'beside' to 'in the center of' the throne.

Too easy. John the Baptist naming Jesus as the one 'who takes away sin' points straight to the well-known phrase 'Lamb of God', which is itself an accepted answer. This single clue gives the word away, so it is not medium hard.
